title: Regression: `run_tests.sh` with `-x` will fail due to expecting extra argument
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

Prior to https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19549 merging

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -c acl/test_acl.py -x` returns error:
`./run_tests.sh: option requires an argument -- x`

### Impact of this regression

Can't run `run_tests.sh` with `-x` argument

### Relevant log output

```shell
In https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19549 it looks like a `:` was accidentally added after the `x` argument indicating that `-x` takes an extra argument:

- while getopts "h?a:b:Bc:C:d:e:Ef:F:H:i:I:k:l:m:n:oOp:q:rs:S:t:ux" opt; do
+ while getopts "h?a:b:Bc:C:d:e:Ef:F:H:i:I:k:l:m:n:oOp:q:rs:S:t:ux:w" opt; do
```

```shell

```

_No response_

linkedPullRequests.title: Removing argument expectation after option `-x`
linkedPullRequests.author: arista-nwolfe
linkedPullRequests.body:
Added accidentally in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19549
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19687

Without this we'll see runs with `-x` fail with:
```
sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -c acl/test_acl.py -x
./run_tests.sh: option requires an argument -- x
```

Summary:
Fixes #19687
